CONCLUSION This work presents the design and experimental testing of a SST that can respond to common-mode (CM) insults, such as those generated by a high altitude electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) or solar-geomagnetic disturbance (GMD). The power electronics and controls architecture of the proposed SSTaredescribed,andhardwareresultsofaprototypeSSTare provided. The SST is shown to function as an effective ac/ac converter during normal operations, and respond successfully to mitigate CM current during a simulated CM insult.
